Product descriptionRAIHOMKIT 10 PCS Brass S Hooks, Gold S Hooks for Hanging Coat Clothes, Heavy Duty S Shaped Hook for Kitchen Pots Pans Cups
Our sturdy brass S-shaped hooks feature a smooth finish and versatile design, perfect for securely hanging pots, coats and more around the home.
These elegant gold S-shaped hooks are durable, stylish, and can be easily hung on existing rods or racks without any installation.
Specifications:
Color: Gold
Material: Brass
Size: 3.54 inch/9 cm in length
3.5 mm in thickness
Packaging Includes:
10 PCS Brass S Hooks
Note:
1.Please confirm the size before buying.
2.Please allow slight errors on size due to manual measurement.

Package Includes: You will receive 10pcs gold S-shaped hooks measuring 3.54 inches (9 cm) in length, 0.14 inches (3.5 mm) in thickness, with a 1.2-inch (3 cm) opening, perfect for securely hanging various items around your home.
Material: Our S-shaped hooks are made of sturdy brass with a smooth finish, ensuring durability and preventing scratches or hand injuries while securely holding your items.
S Shape Design: These well-crafted S-shaped hooks feature an elegant design and can be easily hung on existing rods or racks without installation, screws, or nails.
Gold S Hook: These gold S-shaped hooks are not only durable but also stylish, featuring an elegant golden finish that complements various décor styles and fits perfectly in any room.

Wide Application: These S-shaped hooks are versatile and perfect for use in kitchens, closets, bathrooms, and more. They can be used to hang pots, pans, cups, towels, coats, clothes, keys, and other household items.
